summary: Tested 4 new Database Pelanggan features (Export CSV/XLSX, Order History drawer, Edit, Delete + WhatsApp link) plus regression on dedupe. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed in test_database_features.py (export CSV returns text/csv with 'Nama Penerima'/'No. HP' headers respecting search filter; XLSX returns openxmlformats content-type with PK magic bytes; GET /customers/{id}/orders returns customer+orders with required fields, 404 on unknown; PUT /customers/{id} persists changes and returns 400 on empty or duplicate phone, 404 on unknown id; DELETE removes customer AND its orders, subsequent GET returns 404; dedupe still increments order_count and marks is_repeat=true). Frontend Playwright: owner login -> Database Pelanggan -> search 'ui_test_user' -> whatsapp-link-0 href is 'https://wa.me/6285711223344' (digits-only from +62 phone) -> export-csv-button fires /api/customers/export?format=csv 200 text/csv -> export-xlsx-button fires format=xlsx 200 openxml -> clicking customer-row-0 opens history-drawer with 1 order-item -> edit-customer-0 opens modal, changing recipient_name via edit-field-recipient_name and clicking edit-save-button persists ('UI TestBuyer Edited' visible in table) -> reopening edit with empty phone shows 'Nomor HP wajib diisi' inline error and blocks save -> delete-customer-0 -> confirm-delete-button shows 'Pelanggan dihapus' toast and row disappears.
critical_code_review_comments: Database.js is 464 lines and holds fetching, filtering, export, history, edit and delete concerns; consider extracting the history drawer, edit modal and delete confirm into their own components for readability (not blocking).

PUT /api/customers/{id} accepts CustomerUpdate with all fields defaulting to empty string; if the frontend forgets to send a field, existing values will be wiped. Current UI does send the full object so it's fine, but a safer server-side default of leaving unspecified fields untouched (partial update) would be more robust.

DELETE /api/customers/{id} does not verify ObjectId format; passing a malformed id will raise InvalidId 500 instead of 404. Consider try/except on ObjectId conversion in the customer_orders, update_customer and delete_customer handlers to return a clean 400.
Backend export uses pandas + openpyxl which is heavy at import; acceptable but a lazy import inside the endpoint (already done) is good.

Frontend export handler uses window.URL.createObjectURL & anchor click — this works but does not verify success via the server response; a failed 4xx would still create an empty blob before hitting the catch since axios rejects non-2xx by default so toast.error fires — OK.
seed_data_creation: Test data created (TEST_ prefix, still in DB): TEST_ExpBuyer_Updated (+6285700110022), TEST_Clasher (+6285700998877), TEST_Reg (+6285700555566). Plus 'UI TestBuyer Edited' was created and then deleted during the frontend flow. Original Rizka F / Dewi Anggraini seeds untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests/. Run serially (`-o addopts=""`) to avoid xdist race conditions on shared DB fixtures. All 4 new endpoints + WhatsApp UI + dedupe regression verified working end-to-end.
